info.name: Trellis
info.description:
Local API collection for the Trellis service.

Run the folders in order (Collection Runner works). Variables are stored on the collection; set baseUrl if the service is not on localhost:8080.

1. Health
2. Task types
3. Workflows (read the seeded SAMPLE_ONBOARDING workflow)
4. Build a workflow (create, edit, publish, version)
5. Execute a workflow (the runtime API: validation, dependencies, side effects, hooks, submit, reset)
6. Media, Mock services, Utility

request.description: Creates or updates the 8 task types (ROOT, SECTION, TAB, TEXT, RADIO_BUTTON, DROPDOWN, CHECKBOX, IMAGE). The seed loader already does this on startup.

item.name: 4. Build a workflow

body.raw:
{
  "name": "Demo from API",
  "description": "Built step by step from Postman",
  "tenantId": "{{tenantId}}",
  "workflowCode": "DEMO_{{$timestamp}}",
  "createdBy": "{{userEmail}}"
}

request.description: Each task's meta is validated against its task type's JSON schema. parentTaskId/childTaskIds define the tree; the ROOT task's childTaskIds order the sections.
Creating a task does not attach it to a parent. Step 4 does that.
Publishing needs header x-user-roles: TRELLIS-WORKFLOW-PUBLISHER. Clients can only execute published workflows.

item.name: 13. Start an edit (creates a draft copy)
14. Change a task in the edit draft
16. Publish the edit as a new version
18. Copy SAMPLE_ONBOARDING into a new workflow

body.raw:
{
  "name": "Copy of sample onboarding",
  "description": "Copied from the seed",
  "tenantId": "{{tenantId}}",
  "workflowCode": "COPY_{{$timestamp}}",
  "createdBy": "{{userEmail}}"
}

item.name: 20. Import tasks from a JSON file (pick postman/sample-import-tasks.json)

request.description: Multipart upload. In the Body tab, select postman/sample-import-tasks.json for the file field. The import runs in the background; then call GET /workflows/all to find it.

item.description: Creates a new workflow code from scratch, publishes it, then edits it and publishes version 2.

item.name: 5. Execute a workflow

request.description: Generates a fresh assetId (one execution = one asset). Run this again to start over.

exec: pm.test('webhook for this asset', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().some(w => w.body && w.body.assetId === pm.collectionVariables.get('assetId'))).to.eql(true));

item.description: Runs one asset through SAMPLE_ONBOARDING. Uses the same endpoints a mobile client calls.

item.name: Upload file to URL (choose a file in Body)

request.description: System-input tasks are filled by the server, not the user. Only works on a draft (unpublished) workflow.
Copies the source workflow's tasks into the target draft. Fails if the target is published.
